text:
Juniper Ridge Cabin – Quiet Woods near Maple Hollow

Tucked at the end of a gravel road, this log cabin backs onto a forest trail system and a small creek. Read by the fire, hike straight from the porch, or drive 15 minutes into Maple Hollow for groceries and the Saturday farmers market.

Sleeping arrangements
Bedroom 1: king bed
Bedroom 2: two twin beds

Amenities
- Fireplace
- Full kitchen
- Wi-Fi (satellite, can be slow)
- Charcoal grill
- Washer and dryer

Rules
- No smoking inside the cabin
- Leash pets on the trails
- Quiet hours after 10 PM

Check-in is flexible, just send us your arrival time.
Rate: $140/night, 2-night minimum. Cleaning fee $60.
Address: 1180 Juniper Ridge Road, Maple Hollow
